name: F1_current_evaluation
formula: (state = EXECUTE_MEASURE | state = COMPUTE_ENERGY) -> (bound_version = iter & bound_cand = cands_done)

name: F4_iteration_reset
formula: G ((state = CHECK_STOP & !converged & iter < MAX_ITERS) -> X (state = BIND & cands_done = 0))

name: T2_done_reason
formula: state = DONE -> (term_reason = DONE_CONVERGED | (term_reason = DONE_MAX_ITERS & iter = MAX_ITERS))

name: T5_success_reason
formula: G ((state = CHECK_STOP & converged) -> X (state = DONE & term_reason = DONE_CONVERGED))

name: T6_budget_reason
formula: G ((state = CHECK_STOP & !converged & iter = MAX_ITERS) -> X (state = DONE & term_reason = DONE_MAX_ITERS))

name: T9_update_accounting
formula: G ((next(iter) = iter | next(iter) = iter + 1) & (next(iter) = iter + 1 <-> (state = OPTIMIZER_STEP & !optimizer_error)))
